Hi Mitch. Your Magic M. 40T hasn't shipped yet. Its ship date is now November 30, 2026, and the Diagnostics + 3-Month RMA goes in the same box.

I'm sorry. We gave you October 31 in this chat twice and didn't keep it. Production stopped over a control board issue, which is now fixed. We emailed you about it on November 3 and November 8, so check your spam if those didn't reach you. Tracking comes by email as soon as your miner ships.

You can follow the shipment to our warehouse here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status
